mascot: Tick and Tock — twin hummingbirds: Tick looks back at yesterday and Tock looks ahead to tomorrow, and together they chase verbs through time.

slides.title: Three Time Zones ⏳
slides.text: Every action has three time zones: past (already done), present (happening now) and future (still to come). Verbs change to show the time!
slides.spoken: Past, present, future — verbs change to show the time!

slides.title: Simple Past 📜
slides.text: The simple past is finished: I ate, she went, we saw. Some verbs just add -ed: play became played. Others change completely!
slides.spoken: The simple past is finished: I ate, she went, we saw!

slides.title: Simple Present 🕐
slides.text: The simple present happens again and again: I eat mangoes, she goes to school every day. With he, she or it, we add -s or -es!
slides.spoken: The simple present happens again and again: she goes every day!

slides.title: Simple Future 🔮
slides.text: The simple future uses 'will': I will eat, we will go, they will see. It has not happened yet!
slides.spoken: The simple future uses will: I will eat, we will go!

slides.title: Trick Champions 🏆
slides.text: Some verbs change completely: eat became ate, go became went, see became saw, run became ran. Meet them once and never forget them!
slides.spoken: Eat-ate, go-went, see-saw, run-ran — tricky verbs to remember!

challenges.question: What is the past tense of 'eat'?
challenges.hint: Eat is a tricky verb — it changes completely in the past!
challenges.misconception: The past of eat is ate — 'Yesterday I ate a mango.' 'Eated' is not a word!

challenges.question: What is the past tense of 'go'?
challenges.hint: Go is another changer — its past form is a brand-new word!
challenges.misconception: The past of go is went — 'I went to the park.' 'Goed' is not a word!

challenges.question: What is the past tense of 'run'?
challenges.hint: Run changes its middle sound in the past: r-u-n becomes r-a-n!
challenges.misconception: The past of run is ran — 'She ran fast.' 'Runned' is not a word!

challenges.question: Fill the blank (present tense): 'She ___ to school every day.'
challenges.hint: Every day means present tense — and with she we add -es!
challenges.misconception: 'She goes to school every day' is present tense — with she, go becomes goes!

challenges.question: Fill the blank (future): 'Tomorrow, we ___ visit the museum.'
challenges.hint: Tomorrow needs the future helper word!
challenges.misconception: 'Tomorrow, we will visit the museum' — will makes the future tense!

challenges.question: Which sentence shows the past tense?
challenges.hint: Wrote is the past form of write!
challenges.misconception: 'I wrote a letter.' is past tense — wrote already happened!

challenges.question: Drag each word into its time zone: past, present or future?
challenges.hint: Danced and sang are done. Dance and sing happen now. Will dance is coming!
challenges.misconception: Danced and sang are past. Dance and sing are present. Will dance is future!

challenges.question: What is the past tense of 'see'?
challenges.hint: See changes to a brand-new word in the past!
challenges.misconception: The past of see is saw — 'I saw a rainbow.' 'Seen' needs a helper word like have.
